title: Hamza Tamyachte

profile.name: Hamza Tamyachte
about: I build and maintain e-learning platforms on Moodle: plugins, course formats, integrations, reporting and the servers they run on.
In my spare time I make small web apps and games for the iPhone. They are all listed on this page, free to use and they work offline.

tip: Tip: on iPhone, open an app in Safari, tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen" to run it full screen and offline.

items.name: Hanoi
items.description: Move the tower, one disc at a time. Earn stars, coins and themes.

items.name: Color Sort
items.description: Sort the balls so every tube holds one color. 30 levels, stars and themes.

items.name: Block Pop
items.description: Drag blocks onto the grid, fill rows and columns to pop them. Chase your best score.

items.name: Park Workout
items.description: Workout timer: routines for every goal, levels 1 to 10, rounds and rest, voice cues.
